v1.0.7 Update
- Isekai Returners now supports up to six Cast roles across its lobby, Party Roster, Theater of the Mind, and Guild Rules. Added roles receive matching elements; removing roles closes gaps and renumbers the remaining members.
- Added English text, example records, character names, and part previews for Isekai Returners. Its Language variable offers Auto, Korean, and English.
- The Guild Rules signature count now shows how many members have checked their agreement box.
- Fixed overlaps between the first scene thumbnail and SCENE label, and between the Open sheet tab and rank coin.

  • The Guild Rules signature count now shows how many members have checked their agreement box.
  • Fixed overlaps between the first scene thumbnail and SCENE label, and between the Open sheet tab and rank coin.
